vibe_rationale: Genuine Shonan surf, skate and BMX scene with a single-fin jam, but contest-led and branded by a retailer, so thinner on community programming.
fit_notes: Active-lifestyle beach crowd, but it may skew young (adult share unverified) and wellness adjacency is moderate. Murasaki Sports holds the title and is the retailer host, so a direct approach goes through them. A dozen-plus partners, including Billabong and Red Bull, show brand partnerships work. Japan-based.
